samples.question: Four equal-size dark dashed circles (rings) are drawn, one in each quadrant of the image (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right). Each ring is broken into straight dashes of equal length with equal gaps between them, all around the ring. The number of dashes is how many separate line segments make up the ring. Exactly three of the rings have the same number of dashes, while the fourth ring has a different number of dashes. Which quadrant contains the ring whose number of dashes is different from the other three?
